title: Adaptive Densification for High-Fidelity and Efficient Sparse Gaussian Splatting in Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2606.29400v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution (ASR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution images at any continuous magnification. While 2D Gaussian Splatting (GS) has recently shown great promise for ASR, current methods struggle to balance visual quality and computational cost. Approaches targeting high fidelity rely on powerful backbones and uniform, highly dense Gaussian grids, leading to prohibitive memory and inference costs. Conversely, methods prioritizing efficiency aggressively simplify their architectures, severely compromising visual quality. To bridge this gap, we observe that a core capability of GS remains largely underexplored in ASR: the potential for dynamic densification, i.e., the spatially adaptive allocation of Gaussians based on image content. Unlike standard scene fitting, where densification is guided by a known ground truth, applying this to ASR is highly non-trivial because the high-resolution target is exactly what

translated_title: 面向任意尺度超分辨率中高保真且高效稀疏高斯泼溅的自适应稠密化方法
translated_abstract: 任意尺度超分辨率（ASR）旨在以任意连续的放大倍率重建高分辨率图像。虽然二维高斯泼溅（GS）最近在ASR中展现出巨大前景，但现有方法难以平衡视觉质量与计算成本。追求高保真的方法依赖强大的骨干网络以及均匀且高度密集的高斯网格，导致极高的内存和推理成本；相反，优先考虑效率的方法则激进地简化其架构，严重损害了视觉质量。为了弥合这一差距，我们观察到GS的一项核心能力在ASR中仍未得到充分探索：动态稠密化的潜力，即基于图像内容在空间上自适应地分配高斯。与标准场景拟合中稠密化由已知真值引导不同，将该能力应用于ASR极具挑战性，因为高分辨率目标正是任务本身所要重建的内容（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出在任意尺度超分辨率中利用基于图像内容的自适应动态稠密化机制来分配稀疏高斯，从而同时实现高保真重建与高计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive dynamic densification mechanism that spatially allocates sparse Gaussians based on image content for arbitrary-scale super-resolution, achieving both high-fidelity reconstruction and computational efficiency.
